name: RE: Hero Academia
source:
RE: Hero Academia is a parody erotic game based on the anime series My Hero Academia, where you, a Pro Hero, fresh graduate from U.A was killed in action and saved by a mysterious Quirk.

Given a second chance, it's time to hone your power, get closer to allies in order to solve the mystery of your future, and try to avoid your impending doom. 

You will be able to experience many lewd situations with your favorite characters along the way. Fair price for dying once, right?

[From [url=https://double-h-301.itch.io/re-hero-academia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
RE：英雄学院是一款根据动漫系列《我的英雄学院》改编的恶搞色情游戏，在游戏中，你是一位刚从美国毕业的职业英雄，在行动中被杀，并被一个神秘的怪人所救。

如果有第二次机会，是时候磨练你的力量，与盟友拉近关系，以解开你未来的谜团，并尽力避免即将到来的厄运。

一路上你将能够与你最喜欢的角色一起经历许多猥亵的情况。死一次的合理价格，对吗？

[来自[url=https://double-h-301.itch.io/re-hero-academia]Itch.io[/url]]
